message.content:
Pixel-perfect audit of shared components and global CSS against Webflow reference.

BASE: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq

## SP11 — SHARED COMPONENTS (100 bugs target)

### Navbar — 30 bugs
- Webflow ref: navbar HTML in boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html (look for nav-23-wrapper class)
- Webflow CSS: grep "nav-23" in boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css
- Local: src/components/layout/navbar.tsx + navbar.module.css
Check: nav height, logo size, link spacing, dropdown positioning, sticky behavior CSS, mobile hamburger, dropdown item padding, coming-soon badge styling, CTA button sizing in nav

### Footer — 30 bugs
- Webflow ref: footer HTML in index.html
- Local: src/components/layout/footer.tsx + footer.module.css
Check: footer grid columns, newsletter card layout, link column spacing, social icon sizes, copyright text styling, padding values

### Beta CTA — 20 bugs
- Local: src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx + beta-cta.module.css
- Compare against boldteq-v1-0.webflow/component-*.html OR beta popup in index.html
Check: modal dimensions, panel layout, badge styling, checkmark spacing, urgency card, CTA button sizes

### CTA Banner — 10 bugs
- Local: src/components/shared/cta-banner.module.css
- Compare against index.html .blue-sec / .book-section
Check: padding (exact: 40px 20px 50px), border-radius 20px, heading size, subtitle size

### Newsletter Signup — 10 bugs
- Local: src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.module.css

## SP12 — GLOBALS (100 bugs target)

### globals.css
- Check every CSS variable value against Webflow design tokens
- Check typography scale: h1/h2/h3/h4/p font-sizes match Webflow
- Check color variables match Webflow palette exactly
- Check spacing scale correctness

### Layout — src/app/layout.tsx
- Font loading correct (4 weights loaded, display swap)
- Skip link exists with proper :focus reveal
- Body font class applied
- Sentry + PostHog init correct

### Responsive gaps — check ALL module.css files
Run: find src -name "*.module.css" | xargs grep -L "@media" 
Files missing @media = potential responsive bugs.
For each file WITH @media: check if all 5 Webflow breakpoints (479/767/991/1280/1440) are covered.

Output ONLY JSONL:
{"id":"SP11-NNNN or SP12-NNNN","sprint":11,"page":"*","section":"navbar|footer|beta-cta|globals","component":"src/...","line":N,"category":"css|structure|content|responsive|a11y","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","title":"...","webflow_ref":"...","local_ref":"...","fix":"...","minutes":N}

Target: 200+ bugs total across SP11+SP12. Be exhaustive — every pixel counts.
